struct Node {
    int data, open, close;
    Node() : data(0), open(0), close(0) {}
    Node(int data, int open, int close) : data(data), open(open), close(close) {}
};

class SegmentTree {
public:
    int n;
    vector<Node> tree;
    
    SegmentTree(int n) : n(n) {
        int size = 1;
        while (size < n) size <<= 1;
        tree.resize(4 * size);
    }
    
    void build(const vector<Node>& nodes) {
        build(0, 0, n - 1, nodes);
    }
    
    void build(int idx, int l, int r, const vector<Node>& nodes) {
        if (l == r) {
            tree[idx] = nodes[l];
            return;
        }
        int mid = (l + r) / 2;
        build((idx << 1) + 1, l, mid, nodes);
        build((idx << 1) + 2, mid + 1, r, nodes);
        tree[idx] = combine(tree[(idx << 1) + 1], tree[(idx << 1) + 2]);
    }
    
    void update(int pos, const Node& node) {
        update(0, 0, n - 1, pos, node);
    }
    
    void update(int idx, int l, int r, int pos, const Node& node) {
        if (pos < l || r < pos) return;
        if (l == r) {
            tree[idx] = node;
            return;
        }
        int mid = (l + r) / 2;
        update((idx << 1) + 1, l, mid, pos, node);
        update((idx << 1) + 2, mid + 1, r, pos, node);
        tree[idx] = combine(tree[(idx << 1) + 1], tree[(idx << 1) + 2]);
    }
    
    Node query(int ql, int qr) {
        return query(0, 0, n - 1, ql, qr);
    }
    
    Node query(int idx, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
        if (qr < l || ql > r) return Node();
        if (ql <= l && r <= qr) return tree[idx];
        int mid = (l + r) / 2;
        return combine(query((idx << 1) + 1, l, mid, ql, qr), 
                      query((idx << 1) + 2, mid + 1, r, ql, qr));
    }
    
    Node combine(const Node& a, const Node& b) {
        int overlap = min(a.open, b.close);
        return Node(a.data + b.data + 2 * overlap, 
                   a.open + b.open - overlap, 
                   a.close + b.close - overlap);
    }
};

class FastReader {
private:
    istream& is;
    string buffer;
    size_t pos;
    
public:
    FastReader(istream& input = cin) : is(input), pos(0) {}
    
    string next() {
        while (true) {
            if (pos >= buffer.size()) {
                if (!getline(is, buffer)) return "";
                pos = 0;
            }
            while (pos < buffer.size() && isspace(buffer[pos])) pos++;
            if (pos >= buffer.size()) continue;
            size_t start = pos;
            while (pos < buffer.size() && !isspace(buffer[pos])) pos++;
            if (start < pos) {
                return buffer.substr(start, pos - start);
            }
        }
    }
    
    int nextInt() { return stoi(next()); }
    long long nextLong() { return stoll(next()); }
    double nextDouble() { return stod(next()); }
    string nextLine() {
        if (!getline(is, buffer)) return "";
        pos = 0;
        return buffer;
    }
};

long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
    return b == 0 ? a : gcd(b, a % b);
}

long long lcm(long long a, long long b) {
    return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
}

bool isPerfectSquare(double x) {
    double r = sqrt(x);
    return r == floor(r);
}

long long modPow(long long base, long long exp, int mod) {
    long long res = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) res = (res * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

long long pow(long long base, long long exp) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) res *= base;
        base *= base;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

long long modInverse(long long a, int mod) {
    return modPow(a, mod - 2, mod);
}

bool isPrime(long long n) {
    if (n < 2) return false;
    if (n == 2 || n == 3) return true;
    if (n % 2 == 0 || n % 3 == 0) return false;
    for (long long i = 5; i * i <= n; i += 6) {
        if (n % i == 0 || n % (i + 2) == 0) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

vector<int> manacher(const string& s) {
    vector<char> chars(s.begin(), s.end());
    int n = chars.size();
    vector<int> d(n, 0);
    for (int i = 0, l = 0, r = -1; i < n; i++) {
        int k = i > r ? 1 : min(d[l + r - i], r - i + 1);
        while (i - k >= 0 && i + k < n && chars[i - k] == chars[i + k]) k++;
        d[i] = k--;
        if (i + k > r) {
            l = i - k;
            r = i + k;
        }
    }
    return d;
}

vector<int> kmp(const string& s) {
    int n = s.length();
    vector<int> pi(n, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = pi[i - 1];
        while (j > 0 && s[i] != s[j]) j = pi[j - 1];
        if (s[i] == s[j]) j++;
        pi[i] = j;
    }
    return pi;
}

double calc(int m, int n) {
    long long total = (long long)n * (n - 1) * (n - 2) / 6;
    double favorable = 0.0;
    if (m >= 3) favorable += (long long)m * (m - 1) * (m - 2) / 6.0;
    if (m >= 2) favorable += (long long)m * (m - 1) / 2.0 * (n - m);
    if (m >= 1 && n - m >= 2) favorable += 0.5 * m * (long long)(n - m) * (n - m - 1) / 2.0;
    return favorable / total;
}

void solve() {
    int n;
    double p;
    cin >> n >> p;
    
    int lo = 0, hi = n - 1;
    while (lo < hi) {
        int mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2;
        double prob = calc(mid, n);
        if (prob >= p) hi = mid;
        else lo = mid + 1;
    }
    cout << lo << '\n';
}

int main() {
